reference: User-supplied Cloudstorm photograph; primary generated asset used as consistency reference for secondary/icon.

prompts.primary: Use case: ui-mockup asset, not a full screen. Create ONE production UI button surface as a transparent PNG, meant to be used behind real HTML text in a Cloudstorm sleep-audio app. Reference image is the actual storm-cloud theme; use its midnight navy/slate blue, soft silver cloud highlights, and extremely subtle lavender. Asset canvas 1200x400 wide. ONE perfectly front-facing rounded rectangle button, centered, horizontal, about 1080x220 pixels, generous truly transparent outside margins. Restrained premium tactile smoked-glass surface, deep navy interior, fine luminous silver/lavender rim, delicate realistic bevel, a wisp of storm cloud texture near left and right edges, center remains dark and calm for white text. Slight dimensional lighting, clearly clickable, not a generic flat rectangle. No background plane, no checkerboard baked in, no floor, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no letters, no text, no symbols, no icons, no moon, no additional buttons, no border frame around the canvas. Preserve clear rounded corners and true alpha. This is the PRIMARY active/action button material; the photo's clouds are color/material inspiration only. Do not reproduce the whole cloud photograph inside the button. Output only the isolated single button artwork.
prompts.secondary: Use case: ui-mockup asset. Generate ONE isolated SECONDARY UI BUTTON surface, transparent PNG with real alpha, for a sleep-audio app. Use attached actual cloud photograph and primary button image as material/color references only. Intended natural canvas 900x300 wide, ONE front-facing horizontally rounded rectangle, approximately 840x230, almost filling the canvas with narrow transparent margins. Midnight navy smoky glass, faint storm-cloud texture only along outer edges, dark quiet center for real white HTML text, restrained thin cool silver/lavender bevel, notably dimmer and calmer than the attached primary button. Premium tactile button, gentle inset sheen, no garish chrome, no neon glow. No text, no icon, no moon, no switch, no extra objects, no duplicate states, no sheet/grid. No surrounding background or baked checkerboard. Output one reusable empty button surface only. Keep the whole outline visible and transparent outside the rounded silhouette.
prompts.icon: Use case: ui-mockup asset. Create ONE isolated small ICON BUTTON BACKPLATE for a Cloudstorm sleep-audio app, transparent PNG real alpha. Intended square canvas 512x512. ONE front-facing rounded square, centered, 440x440, narrow transparent margins. Match the attached cloud photograph's midnight navy and slate blue and the attached button's delicate silver-lavender rim. Smoked dark glass with a subtle tactile beveled edge, wisps of storm clouds ONLY in the corners, dark calm blank center to place a real white SVG icon. Compact quiet interface control, refined rather than ornate; lower brightness than a primary button, no huge glow. No icon, no text, no glyph, no moon, no stars, no extra object, no sheet/grid, no floor, no colored background, no baked checkerboard. Entire rounded square outline visible. Pixels outside the backplate must be truly transparent. Output just one empty reusable square button surface.
